children: On 3 and 4 September 2026, various awards or options under the Diageo 2014 Long Term Incentive Plan and the Diageo Exceptional Stock Award Plan have been released or exercised over Ordinary Shares.
The notifications below, which have been made in accordance with the requirement of the UK Market Abuse Regulation, provide further details.
